name: sensor_modal_evidence
description: Call with the latest 1–4 complete frames from one episode, oldest first, to summarize visible geometry and changes in bilateral tactile evidence alongside measured hand displacement. Defaults require no parameters. Optional camera_rois selects normalized [row_start, column_start, row_end, column_end] regions; marker_change_px and rgb_change set descriptive change thresholds. Output contains latest measurements, adjacent-frame comparisons, a retained window peak, evidence frame indices and recorded steps, coverage, and applicability. Marker comparisons spatially match reference coordinates and remove duplicate reference samples; they never subtract rows across frames. Camera plane normals describe a dominant visible patch only, not an opening or concealed axis. RGB differences may reflect lighting, references may already be loaded, native tactile depth is not indentation, and pixel displacement is not force. Missing or incompatible evidence is null/unknown. One frame provides measurements but no temporal conclusions. No task outcome or physical contact state is inferred. Results stay below 6000 JSON characters.

camera_rois.description: Optional normalized image regions with exclusive end boundaries. Omitted cameras use the full image.

marker_change_px.description: Threshold on median magnitude of spatially matched temporal displacement differences; not a force threshold.

rgb_change.description: Threshold on mean absolute RGB channel difference after normalization.
